# Job Alternate Titles
You can now pick a new title for nearly every job!
Simply go to your loadout and click on the specific jobs name to get a dropdown menu.
Be aware that changing your title does not excuse you from doing the basic expectations of your job, eg. a Firefighter (Atmos Tech) not turning on distro.
Certain jobs have also received a 'Junior' title, if you do not feel quite fully qualified yet.
Like the Jr. Scientist or the Apprentice Engineer.
